purpose.domain_detail: Belgian/French-language HR system: illness/sick-leave register (LIVRE DE MALADIE) for employees, tracking presence, career records, and printing sick-leave forms per person per year
purpose.summary: Program 3-MAL manages a sick-leave register (livre de maladie) for a company HR system. It reads employee registry, career, presence, and contract records, accumulates monthly hours, and prints formatted sick-leave forms via a P080 print module. The program supports interactive screen navigation with function-key control.

notable_features: ACCEPT with LINE/POSITION/SIZE/TAB UPDATE NO BEEP CURSOR (AcuCOBOL screen I/O)
CALL "C$RERR" for extended file error handling (AcuCOBOL runtime)
Heavy use of COPY statements (35 copybooks) for record layouts
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LINK-V with LINKAGE SECTION
EVALUATE used extensively for screen field dispatch
French/Belgian HR domain: MATERNITE, LIVRE DE MALADIE, FIRME, PERSONNE
verdict.notes: Source is in French (Belgian HR context). Latin-1 encoding with box-drawing characters in comments. Program name starts with digit (3-MAL) which is valid in AcuCOBOL.
